acceptance: A recipe boot whose pane shows the marker over a shell process times out instead of returning nil
A recipe boot with the marker and a CLI process still boots
fix: Apply the boot handshake in EnsureSession: with the marker present, keep polling while paneShellProcess reports a shell; consider one paneBootReady predicate both boot waits call.
summary: recipeSessionDriver.EnsureSession accepts the first capture containing the prompt marker; bootTmuxREPL also requires the pane process not to be a shell (guardDeadShell/paneShellProcess). Found 2026-10-05: on the old trust manifest, TestRecipeBoot_TrustDialogIsConfirmedOnYesBeforeReady's red run returned nil with claude exited to zsh, because the lingering dialog's ❯ matched the marker. A CLI that exits during a recipe boot with its marker on screen is treated as booted and the recipe types into the shell.
title: The recipe adapter's boot declares a dead shell ready: EnsureSession has no dead-shell guard
